report:
Reviewed the complete no_inference claim and both ordinary implementation associations: InferCtx::finish and finalize_typed_body. Requirements are (1) successful completed output has no live inference variables, including nested type edges, (2) unresolved semantic choices do not survive completion, and (3) the returned tree remains usable independently of temporary inference state. InferCtx::finish consumes the context, asserts no pending obligations, live branch, live task or pending wake, requires all expression slots to be filled, and passes the temporary stash and egraph into the finalizer. Its finalize phase resolves bounds, reports unbound variables into explicit error types, discharges remaining obligations and drains tasks; errors are not successful choices. The finalizer resolves each type through the root egraph representative, recursively copies type arguments, aliases, references, tuples, arrays, function signatures and dispatch metadata, and panics rather than return an InferVar. It recursively copies expression children, statements, patterns, match arms, closure parameter types and annotations. Unresolved ExprSlot nodes are replaced recursively with their completed expressions; cyclic slots/types are rejected. It allocates a new stash and returns an owning Stashed body. Local metadata has no type edges. Retained aliases and universal parameters are allowed semantic identities, not live inference variables, as the captured types model explicitly explains.

The complete associated test set contains one ordinary fixture and one explicit TODO. finalized_nested_body_owns_resolved_and_imported_types_after_sources_drop now constructs a tuple containing a transient slot and its resolved literal, with an inference variable in the child and tuple type. It asserts the source still has the original inference and slot forms, drops source, imported stash and egraph, then traverses every node/type in that fixture and asserts concrete bool types, literal expression data, shared resolved child identity, spans and empty locals. This detects shallow type copying, leaked slots and dependence on inference/source ownership. The types_body_no_inference TODO remains honestly deferred: a wider completion fixture corpus and full returned-tree traversal across other forms/semantic choices must be collected before broad end-to-end coverage can be claimed. The focused fixture does not discharge that broader TODO; accepting it preserves the explicit coverage limitation. No N/A entries exist.

Additional dependencies were captured through review read: tytree/mod.rs (complete product/edge shape), types.sage (including retained alias semantics), egraph.rs find (representative traversal), and reviews.md (review criteria). New essential finalizer association ensures future changes to finalizer behavior invalidate this review. Verification actually executed: cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-ir finalized_nested_body_owns_resolved_and_imported_types_after_sources_drop --lib (1 passed); cargo build (passed with existing warnings). This is source inspection plus the named focused run, not a claim to have run the complete suite or the deferred fixture corpus. Coordinator owns the centralized post-codegen and Sage sanity review for the evidence-only Rust edits.
